text:
sofia: Seeing tail-latency spikes on apac-edge between 09:02-09:06 UTC. Affected tenants show 95th/p99 token latencies up ~2.4x and egress tx drops on interface tg0.
alex: ack, can you drop the graphs pls (slo and egress counters)?
sofia: pinned dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/apac/egress. here's a quick grep from flow logs for the window:
```
[09:03:12] tg0 tx_drops=420 ifq_len=100 qdisc=fq_codel backlog=34ms
[09:03:13] tenant=acme svc=gen tokens=... latency=820ms
```
raj: that smells like bufferbloat on the egress qdisc / NIC. any CPU steal on the proxy nodes?
linda: proxy-az1 CPU user/system jumped ~12% and NIC interrupts spiked at 09:03. not huge but aligns. could be short multi-tenant jets.
sofia: proposal: run a 30m "slice-swap" experiment — move 3 medium tenants off shared warm slices into reserved micro-silos (ephemeral dedicated) in apac to test if isolation reduces tail.
alex: runbook? steps and rollback?
sofia: runbook sketch: 1) mark tenants: `allocctl mark tenant=acme,zen,orbit swap=reserve-micro`  2) provision micro-silos: `infractl provision micro-silo --region apac --count 3 --prewarm on`  3) migrate routes: `router swap-route --tenants acme,zen,orbit --target micro-silo-ids`  4) monitor: p95/p99 latency, egress tx_drops, NIC interrupts. rollback: `router swap-route --tenants ... --target warm`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: provisioning request queued id=PR-9032
raj: cost note: reserved micro-silos will raise per-token infra cost ~2.8x during the test. ok if we cap to 30m and do canary first.
linda: can we canary just one tenant (acme) first and expand only if we see improvement?
sofia: yes — canary acme only. i'll kick it off and post metrics. if good -> expand. if not -> revert and file infra ticket.
alex: tagging @oncall to watch the canary metrics.
ops-bot: action: provision micro-silo id=micro-apac-22 status=ready
sofia: canary started at 09:08 UTC (migrated acme -> micro-apac-22)
linda: initial numbers: acme p95 down 420ms -> 180ms, p99 down 820ms -> 320ms. egress tx_drops fell to single-digit. promising. :sparkles:
raj: nice. keep 15m observation window then decide to expand.
sofia: agreed. if stable i'll extend to zen+orbit. will capture cost delta.
alex: good run. if this is reproducible we should consider offering "micro-silo" as a paid isolation tier or tune qdisc.
sofia: filing infra ticket: INFRA-1129 — egress qdisc tail-latency; attaching traces and the canary snapshot.
ops-bot: ticket INFRA-1129 created by sofia
sofia: closing thread once we've either rolled out the three-silo swap or reverted. updates incoming.
